segments.title: Lethal Company Modded Marathon Begins
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens a 12+ hour heavily modded Lethal Company stream with Kendelle; early rounds feature cosmetic mods, spray paint mechanics, and high enemy density.

segments.title: Peter Griffin House Map
segments.notes: Crew explores a Family Guy–themed custom map; Paper Mario map fails to load; Case plays as Peter Griffin model with detailed environment recreation.

segments.title: Mario World Map Exploration
segments.notes: Custom Super Mario map with Princess Peach, Yoshi, and Piranha Plant models; crew navigates pipes and hidden areas.

segments.title: Adult Content Discovery in Mario Map
segments.notes: Crew finds NSFW 'sexy Piranha Plant' area with suggestive animations; Case jokes about Twitch after-dark rules and losing 'lethal company virginity'.

segments.title: In-Game Drawing Minigame & Quota Completion
segments.notes: Players use a clipboard drawing mod for improvised comedy (Pornhub ad parody, political slogans); quota reached, transition to Titan moon.

segments.title: Titan Moon & Fitness Gram Interruption
segments.notes: Brief Titan gameplay; beep test audio plays over comms; Kendall's game crashes requiring rejoin.

segments.title: Return to Peter Griffin House & Simpsons Map Prep
segments.notes: Crew revisits Peter Griffin map; Fiona mentions streaming retirement; decision to uninstall Peter/Paper Mario mods and download Peach's Castle and Simpsons Hit & Run map.

segments.title: Simpsons Hit & Run Open World Map
segments.notes: Massive Springfield/Quimbyville recreation from racing game; no enemies, huge scale causes navigation confusion; players fall through map geometry repeatedly.

segments.title: Peach's Castle Finale & Stream Conclusion
segments.notes: Final map: Princess Peach's Castle with Toad filter, nutcrackers, Arumba, and FNAF animatronics; Case ends 14-hour stream, announces possible Tuesday return.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors 14-hour modded Lethal Company marathon, cycles through Peter Griffin, Toad, and cow suits while wrangling guest players and map installs.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Co-op partner throughout the marathon; survives map transitions, game crashes, and Simpsons map geometry failures alongside Case.

lore_notes.fact: Completed a 14-hour continuous modded Lethal Company stream starting at noon, ending at ~4 AM [03:21:31].
Participated for the full duration as Case's primary co-op partner across all custom maps [03:21:31].
Broadcast originated from Case's home streaming room with heavy mod load (1000+ mods) causing PC performance issues [02:26:23].

episode_summary: Case Blackwell and Kendelle host a 14-hour modded Lethal Company endurance stream, cycling through custom maps including a detailed Peter Griffin house, a Super Mario world with adult-content Easter eggs, a massive Simpsons Hit & Run open-world recreation, and Princess Peach's Castle. Guest players Fiona, Fancy, and Exterminator join for various segments. The broadcast concludes with Case announcing a likely return on Tuesday after travel.
